title: Question 12
passage:
Who checked the serial numbers on the monitors we received today?
A. Maya in receiving did. B. They’re printed on the back. C. They arrived in four cartons.
passageZh:
今天收到的螢幕，是誰核對序號的？
A. 收貨組的 Maya 核對的。
B. 序號印在背面。
C. 螢幕分四箱送來。
